description: Abstract capability-tier routing policy for Google Antigravity runtime

fast.description: High-throughput, low-latency tier for small edits, formatting, narrow documentation, and quick status checks

standard.description: Balanced reasoning and code generation for routine implementation, ordinary tests, CRUD, and refactoring

strong.description: Deep architectural reasoning, complex planning, multi-module coordination, and difficult debugging
strong.routingHeuristic: Gemini strong model or Claude Sonnet 4.6

critical.description: Highest rigor for security-sensitive reasoning, cryptographic protocols, root-cause failure analysis, and high-blast-radius validation
critical.routingHeuristic: Claude Opus 4.6 or equivalent strongest available model

escalationRules.onTaskRetry: Promote tier by 1 level if task previously failed (e.g. standard -> strong)
escalationRules.onSecuritySensitive: Promote to critical tier if task modifies auth, encryption, or permissions
escalationRules.onHighUncertainty: Promote to strong if decision confidence < 0.75
